title: My Number Broke the King's Scale
summary: When the king assigns his twin sister to the mines, the smallest boy in town steps on the brass scale and breaks its highest rating.
frame_0: The gilt instrument splits behind Shorty and showers gold over his indigo waistcoat as he raises his block hands to protect his face.
package_differences: Jake's November 25 direction calls for fast cuts. The twins share the same eye height, skin tone and hair colour. The scale splits open, and the larger dial appears behind its broken face.

The original story soundtrack runs for 139.30 seconds. The sponsor edition adds the 9.30-second Flashloop phone performance with the approved voice and an actual shot of the scale breaking. The clean edition ends with the story.
camera: Steady daylight setups with clean cuts on changes of subject and short moves with the action.
